thread:
mina: Quick sync 1: customer asks for a 'Commit Flex' add-on to convert unused commit into credits or swap into burst blocks. Need boundaries for pilot.
oleg: Keep it simple for pilot: allow one conversion per billing period, max 20% of commit, credits expire in 60 days.
tara: Pricing team wants a conversion fee to protect ARR. Recommend 10% fee for pilot conversions.
rebecca: Legal: add clause that conversions are one-way and non-refundable, and that credits are non-transferable unless enterprise-negotiated.
mina: Ops: how do we surface this in billing? Need explicit invoice line and a flag in exports so finance can trace revenue recognition.
oleg: Implementation sketch: record event as ADJ-FLEX-CONV with fields in export: tenant_id, month, converted_tokens, fee_amount.

```
# enforcement
allow_conversion = true
max_pct = 0.20
frequency = "monthly"
```

rebecca: Also require audit trail on console for customer actions and admin override path for disputes.
tara: Launch gating proposal: - 2 paying pilots signed - billing export shows ADJ lines - console UI shows one-click conversion - legal text approved
legal-bot: Action created: doc-req-4209 (attach amendment template). mina: I'll own pilot comms and collect sign-offs. :thumbsup:
